What changed since RC1
  * High-resolution plain lettering (menus, lap/finish times, save screen,
    dialogue) drawn from real typefaces. The game's own colourful lettering
    and the race HUD are untouched. On in Restored and Remastered, with a
    High-resolution text switch under Video. Original mode is unaffected.
  * The RC1 WebGPU frame-admission change was investigated and REVERTED: the
    problem it targeted turned out to be an artifact of the test harness's
    synthetic clock, not something players hit. Frame admission in this build
    is identical to shipped 1.1.0.

Defaults are unchanged
  Motion smoothing and the camera correction remain OFF and are not
  recommended in the launcher. Nothing in this candidate changes a default
  a player sees.

NOT a release
  No tag, no GitHub release, no web demo push. Built for device acceptance
  per docs/DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE_SMOOTHING.md.
